verdict.rationale: The pack shows Dropbox has API reference pages (Content Hash, OAuth, Webhooks) and a static code snippet in the JavaScript SDK README. Nothing shows an interactive reference where examples can be run in the browser, so static docs and snippets earn no credit for this story. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on every candidate path, so there is no machine-readable spec in evidence either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
